mapper.select: select count(td.id) from patient_base_info pbi inner join td_diagnosis td on pbi.patient_id = td.patient_id where td.result_date = #{startDate}

select pbi.id baseId,pbi.patient_id ,pbi.account_id ,pbi.registry_signs ,pbi.medical_record_no ,pbi.name ,pbi.birthday ,pbi.age ,pbi.sex ,pbi.marital_status , pbi.nation ,pbi.id_card ,pbi.mobile ,pbi.present_address ,pbi.admission_hospital_date ,pbi.admission_hospital_date , pbi.discharge_hospital_date ,pbi.dept_discharge_from ,pbi.last_visit_date ,pbi.patient_clinic_time, td.diagnosis_type ,td.diagnosis_no ,td.diagnosis_desc ,td.diagnosis_date,td.id,'1' esDataType from patient_base_info pbi inner join td_diagnosis td on pbi.patient_id = td.patient_id where td.result_date = #{startDate} order by td.id asc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(tgi.id) from td_general_inspection tgi inner join patient_base_info pbi on tgi.patient_id = pbi.patient_id where tgi.result_date = '2021-01-01'

select pbi.id baseId,'2' esDataType,pbi.patient_id ,pbi.account_id ,pbi.registry_signs ,pbi.medical_record_no ,pbi.name ,pbi.birthday ,pbi.age ,pbi.sex ,pbi.marital_status , pbi.nation ,pbi.id_card ,pbi.mobile ,pbi.present_address ,pbi.admission_hospital_date ,pbi.admission_hospital_date , pbi.discharge_hospital_date ,pbi.dept_discharge_from ,pbi.last_visit_date ,pbi.patient_clinic_time, tgi.id,tgi.recording_date ,tgi.height ,tgi.weight,tgi.waistline,tgi.pulse,tgi.bmi,tgi.pulse_rate, tgi.systolic_blood_pressure,tgi.diastolic_blood_pressure,tgi.body_temperature,tgi.respiratory_rate from td_general_inspection tgi inner join patient_base_info pbi on tgi.patient_id = pbi.patient_id where tgi.result_date = #{startDate} order by tgi.id asc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select count(tem.id) from patient_base_info pbi inner join td_exam_master tem on pbi.patient_id = tem.patient_id left join td_auxiliary_examination_ct taec on tem.exam_no = taec.exam_no left join td_auxiliary_examination_nmr taen on tem.exam_no = taen.exam_no left join td_auxiliary_examination_ultrasound taeu on tem.exam_no = taeu.exam_no left join td_auxiliary_examination_other taeo on tem.exam_no = taeo.exam_no where tem.exam_date = #{startDate}
